argv: $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'AgentOS\scripts'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root|Out-Null; $src='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alston-personal/agentmanager/fix/windows-thin-client-watchdog/scripts/windows/thin_client_watchdog.ps1'; $dst=Join-Path $root 'thin_client_watchdog.ps1'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $src -OutFile $dst; $a=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument ('-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+$dst+'" -TaskName "AgentOS Thin Client"'); $t1=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User $env:USERNAME; $t2=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At (Get-Date).AddMinutes(1) -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1); $p=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME" -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited; $s=New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AgentOS Thin Client Watchdog' -Action $a -Trigger @($t1,$t2) -Principal $p -Settings $s -Force|Out-Null; Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AgentOS Thin Client Watchdog'; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AgentOS Thin Client Watchdog'|Select-Object TaskName,State|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
